data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C–stage AI & Software company seeking valuation guidance against a peer set of 3 same-stage private comparables (Figure AI, Skild AI, Together AI) and 1 public reference (Palantir). The target carries a current post-money valuation of $10.0B following $3B+ in cumulative capital raised.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yields $17.0B from the $10.0B last post-money valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces $14.0B; the peer set ranges from $8.3B (Together AI) to $39.0B (Figure AI), reflecting meaningful dispersion at this stage.

The two methods triangulate to a central estimate of $15.5B (median), bounded by a low of $11.9B and a high of $19.6B. This range sits modestly above the current valuation, suggesting modest upside consistent with stage progression. Key uncertainties center on the wide peer dispersion—a 4.7x spread between floor and ceiling—and the small comparison set of 3 peers, both of which limit precision. Sector momentum and the timing of the next financing event will likely drive realized valuation movement within this band.
